input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with An image generation model is designed to create visual content based on user input, utilizing advanced algorithms to produce a wide range of images. The model's primary function is to generate images that accurately reflect the user's request, while also aiming to minimize the introduction of biases. The system seeks to learn from large datasets and improve its performance over time, generating high-quality images that meet user expectations.
